title: High triboelectrification and charge collection efficiency of a direct current triboelectric nanogenerator achieved by a tri-synergistic enhancement strategy
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03784G, Paper
Shuyan Xu, Jian Wang, Chuncai Shan, Kaixian Li, Huiyuan Wu, Gui Li, Shaoke Fu, Qionghua Zhao, Yi Xi, Chenguo Hu
This work proposes a ternary dual-DC triboelectric nanogenerator (TDD-TENG) with a triple synergy enhancement strategy to improve the charge collection ability and triboelectrification efficiency.
